Maintained 20 MT on MFCT / well commisioner and continued pumping. Pumped seawater at 3100-4000 lpm / SPP 80-130 bar / 60 rpm.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Drilled/scraped cement to 3735 m MD. Tagged TOL at 2809,5 m MD. Dressed off PBR.  Inflow tested well using well commissioner and base oil. Pumped displacement train. Cleaned well with SW and displaced to packer fluid. Tested well to 345 bar. POOH with cleaning assemblies to 3011 m MD.

activities.remarks: Pumped seawater at 3100-4000 lpm / SPP 80-130 bar / 60 rpm. Took consecutive NTU readings on seawater returns: 398/317/224/166/411/580/491/799/1000+/780. Pumped a total of 180 m3 seawater.
Stopped rotation. Pumped packer fluid at 3800 lpm / SPP 118 bar. Took consecutive NTU reading on packer fluid returns: 106/89/80/121/250/130/111/115/125/115. Pumped a total of 270 m3 packer fluid.
Picked up to unset well commissioner and operated MFCT to closed position. Spaced out and closed MPR. Lined up cement unit.
Pressure tested casing/liner to 345 bar / 10 min. Observed 0,5 bar drop / 10 min (0,15%) towards end of test - ok. Pumped and bled back 2280 liter.
Flowchecked well on trip tanks - well static. Meanwhile terminated building 7" tubing stands and prepared for laying out singles / pulling DP.
Broke out and set back 5 1/2" DP stand. Pulled, broke and laid out 4 x 5 1/2" DP singles.
POOH with cleaning assemblies on 5 1/2" DP from 3647 m to 3170 m MD.
Broke out an laid down cleaning assy #5 - 10 3 /4" razor back / posi drift / wellsweep magnets / well patroller.
Broke and laid out 2 x 5 1/2" DP singles. POOH with cleaning assemblies on 5 1/2" DP from 3131 m to 3011 m MD.
POOH with cleaning assemblies on 5 1/2" DP from 3011 m to 2201 m MD. Got problems with HPU indicating hydraulic leakage.
Troubleshot HPU. Found leakage on hose to PS-21 slips. Removed slips. Installed masterbushing to continue pulling pipe using manual slips.
POOH with cleaning assemblies on 5 1/2 DP from 2201 to 2000 m MD. Used manual slips.
Removed masterbushing. Installed PS-21 automatic slips and function tested same.
POOH with cleaning assemblies on 5 1/2" DP from 2000 m to 950 m MD.

Broke out and laid out cleaning assy#4 - MFCT / well patroller / wellsweep magnet and cleaning assy #3 - polish/top-dress mill / well commissioner / wellsweep magnets. Recovered 4 kg swarf on magnets. Nothing recovered in well patrollers.
Set up AFT PRS for racking 3 1/2" DP stands. Not able to rack stands using AFT PRS.

Troubleshot racking problem. Calibrated fwd PRS. Attempted to rack pipe with FWD PRS - negative. Calibrated AFT PRS, not able to rack pipe. Had problems with anti-collission system and pipe clashed with racking fingers. Fixed hydraulic leakge on HPU which may have caused malfunction on anti-collision system. Had problems with "pipe set down" function, system not registering when pipe set down. Parked AFT PRS. Continued to troubleshot FWD PRS. Attempted to rack stand of pipe - ok.
POOH with cleaning assemblies on 3 1/2" DP from 920 m to 30 m MD. Racked back 3 1/2" DP in foldable fingerboard using FWD PRS. Removed automatic slips and installed masterbushings.
Pulled and laid out 2 x 3 1/2" DP singles. Broke and laid out cleaning assy #2 - 7" razor back / wellsweep magnets. Broke and laid out cleaning assy #1 - 6 " PDC bit.
Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment. Lifted VMB plug onto HTS.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: POOH with cleaning string to 920 m MD. Laid down cleaning assy#4 and #3. Not able to rack 3 1/2" DP. Troubleshot situation with FWD/AFT PRS. POOH with 3 1/2" DP and racked back in derrick. Laid down cleaning assy #2 and #1. RIH and set 9 5/8" VMB plug at 637 m MD. Tested below plug to 380 bar. Spotted hi-vis and POOH with running tool.

activities.remarks: Picked up and hung off VMB plug / setting tool in rotary.
RIH with VBM plug / setting tool on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 608 m MD.
RIH on last stand to 638 m MD while circualting packer fluid at 800 lpm / SPP 2 bar. Stopped pumping. Took up/down weights 95/89 MT.

Rotated pipe clockwise at 15 rpm and slacked off weight. Stopped rotation and set down to 60 MT. Took 30 MT overpull to confirm plug set. Confirmed plug set with packer element at 636,5 m MD and top of plug at 634 m MD.

Set down to 87 m MT in block. Made 3 attempts to shear sleeve for closing ball vavle (3/4, 1,5 and 2 lefthand turns)- nogo. On 4th attempt the shear sleeve sheared out just after 2 turn and 3100 Nm applied torque. Pressured up to 30 bar on string above plug. Rotated string righthand to re-open ball valve and observed pressure dropping to 16 bar.

Lined up cement unit. Pressured up to 280 bar, observed losing ~10 MT weight on plug. Picked up weight to 82 MT on block. Continued pressuring up to 380 bar, observed losing ~4 MT on plug. Held test for 20 min, last 10 min 0,5 bar drop (0,13%). Pumped and bled back 1880/1800 liter.
Rotated DP lefthand to close ball valve. Applied 30 bar on DP to check that ball valve closed.
Picked up 5 m to get free of plug. Spotted 5 m3 hi-vis pill on top of plug at 1500 lpm / SPP 4 bar. Chased hi-vis with packer fluid.
POOH with VMB plug setting tool on 5 1/2" DP from 628 m to 130 m MD.
Removed PS-30 slips. Installed masterbushing.
POOH with VMB plug setting tool on 5 1/2" HWDP from 130 m MD to surface.

Laid down VMB plug setting tool. Prepared WBRRT for retrieveing wearbushing. Held toolbox talk and handover meeting. Meanwhile closed shear ram and lined up cement unit to pump down kill line. Pressure tested VMB plug from above to 345 bar / 10 min (0,2% drop).
Reset WBRRT according to Vetco instructions.  RIH to 140 m MD on 5 1/2" DP and engaged tool. Pulled free wearbushing with 34 MT overpull.
POOH with WBRRT and wear bushing.
Released and laid out wearbushing. Reset WBRRT according to Vetco instructions. Laid down WBRRT.
Made up jetting sub to stand of 5 1/2" HWDP. RIH on 2 x stands of 5 1/2" HWDP to 115 m MD.
Made up PADPRT to 18 3/4" lock down sub. Landed PADPRT on 10 3/4" casing hanger at 139 m MD. Set down 7 MT on PADPRT and rotated 4 1/4" turns to initiate locking sequence.
Performed line test from cement unit to kill lline HCR. 35/345 bar 5/10 min - ok. Closed LPR.

Made 4 attempts to set lock down sub by pressuring up between LPR and PADPRT. Observed too high volumes pumped and no pressure building up. Repeated setting procedure 3 times but obtained same negative result.
POOH with PADPRT and lockdown sub from 139 m MD to surface. Inspected lockdown sub and found score marks indicating junk preventing proper landing. Broke out and set back PADPRT.
Picked up stand. Made up TDS and RIH with jet sub to +/- 140 m MD. Made 3 passes and jetted across wellhead at 4100 lpm / SPP 65 bar. Pumped a total of 45 m3 packer fluid.
Racked back stand used for jetting. Picked up and made up PADPRT. RIH on 5 1/2" HWDP and landed PADPRT at 139 m MD. Rotated string and set down weight as instructed by Vetco.
Closed LPR and lined up from cement unit to pump in BOP kill line. Pressurised above PADPRT in 35 bar increments up to 207 bar to set lock down sub - ok.
Disengaged from lock down sub. POOH on 5 1/2" HWDP from surface. Laid out PADRT tool and jet sub.

Ran in with stand of 5 1/2" DP. Closed annular. Purged air in kill line in atttempt to empty riser and BOP. POOH with stand of DP. The BOP was accidentally left closed when pulling.stand, weight came up rapidly and the last tooljoint slipped through the annular causing a shock.
Inspected drill line and crown block for damage - none found.
Cleared and tidied drillfloor before removing diverter.
Removed elevator and installed sling for pulling diverter. Remove master bushing and outer ring.
Pulled diverter and set back on drillfloor.
Attached sling to diverter slick joint, pulled and laid out slickjoint.
Rigged down slings. Installed outer ring, masterbushing and hole cover.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: POOH with VMB setting tool. Tested VMB plug to 345 bar / 10 min from above. Retrieved wear bushing. RIH with lock down sub on PADPRT. Not able to set lock down sub. Washed/jetted wellhead. Set lock down sub. Pulled diverter and nippled down BOP. Picked up and landed claxton tool on BOP joint. Made up claxton tool.

activities.remarks: Removed BOP tension cylinders. Nippled down BOP. Removed/rebuilt scaffolding. Moved BOP to starboard setback area in moonpool. Meanwhile made up PR tension joint handling flange to stand of DP. Ran guidewire for hotstab. ROV engaged hotstab in TBC receptacle.
Held toolbox / short change handover meeting.

Picked up claxton tool. Removed outer ring and master bushing and ran claxton tool through RT. Installed outer ring and master bushing. Hung off claxton tool on pup joint. Made up 5 1/2" DP stand, ran in and landed Claxton tool on top of HPDR BOP joint.
Made up studs on claxton tool to 4500 Nm using Hy-torq tool and torque plate.
Cleared tools and equipment from scaffolding in moonpool.
Took 5 MT overpull on riser. Bled down pressure on tension cylinders and transferred tenison to block until 60 MT in block. Meanwhile brought riser spider to drillfoor and function tested same.

Ran cylinders and lowered tensioner assembly. Disconnected tension cylinders and pulled aside. Dismanteled tensioner assembly. Dismanteled contact ring. Hoisted up contact ring. Removed centralizer and boat collision stool. Lowered tension ring onto the protector guide.
Held toolbox talk prior to unlacthing TBC. Confirmed injection well F-4 shut down for heavylift operation.
Pressured up through minireel/hotstab to 3000 psi to unlock the TBC connector.
Removed hotstab in TBC connector and installed dummy stab using ROV.

Lifted off TBC connector and came free from wellhead in on continuos stroke. Pulled claxton tool / HPDR to just under rotary table for setting slips. Set slips. Broke out and set back 5 1/2" DP stand.
Held toolbox talk for installing riser spider.
Removed master bushing and outer ring. Pulled 1st HPDR double - BOP joint and tension joint - through rotary. Installed riser spider in well center. Hung off HPDR in riser spider.

Removed fairings. Broke connection using bolt tensioner tools. Laid out 1st double with simulatneous lift by deck crane and TDS. Installed handling flange type C on 2nd double - upper pup joint and splash zone joint.
POOH with HPDR to 77 m. Removed fairings. Hung off HPDR in riser spider.
Broke connection using bolt tensioner tools. 2 bolt tensioner tools got jammed on bolts. Meanwhile installed VX ring, guide funnel and hole cover on F-5 subsea wellhead.
Freed bolt tensioner tools that jammed/malfunctioned. Traced back up tools.
Continued breaking connection using bolt tensioner tools. Installed handling flange type C on 3rd double - std joint#4 and std joint#5.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Transferd tension from tensioners to block. Disconnected TBC. Pulled HPDR to 24 m.

activities.remarks: Laid out 2nd double with simultaneous lift by deck crane and TDS
POOH with HPDR double to 49 m. Removed fairings. Hung off HPDR in riser spider.
Broke connection using bolt tensioner tools. Installed handling flange type C on 4th double - std joint#2 and lower pup joint.
POOH with HPDR to 24 m. Checked zink anodes. Checked inside TBC for VX ring - none. Removed fairings. Hung off HPDR in riser spider.

Broke connection using bolt tensioner tools. Installed handling flange type C on 5th double - std joint#1, lower pup joint and TBC. Meanwhile removed tension ring 002 and installed tension ring for PR riser (10008802) on Centralizer deck.
Laid out 4th double with simultaneous lift by deck crane and TDS.
Held toolbox talk / handover meeting prior to laying out 5th double.
POOH 5th double - std joint #1, lower pup and TBC to surface. Laid out 5th double with simultaneous lift by deck crane and TDS.
Cleaned and tided drillfloor.
Held toolbox talk for transfering F-5 production coflex hose to XMT deck.
Transferred production coflex hose from drillfloor to XMT deck using tuggers.
Held toolbox talk for picking up production riser and re-arranging hatches in wellherad module.
Removed hatches on slot F-10. Re-arranged/built scaffolding barriers around F-5 and F-10. Configured riser spider for running production riser.
Picked up 1st joint - TBC and stress joint, with simultaneous lift by deck crane and TDS. Chekcked / re-arranged guidwire clamp.

RIH with TBC stress joint and hung off in riser spider. Picked up 1st double - lower pup joint and std joint #1 with simulatneous lift by deck crane and TDS. Removed handling flange on 1 st joint. Made up connection using bolt tensioner tools. Tested flange to 3000 psi through test port - ok. Installed bolt caps and fairings. Attached guidewire slings and fore-runner on TBC / stress joint.
RIH with production riser to 20 m. Function trested TBC and performed pre-operational checks according to Vetco procedure.

RIH with production riser to put guidewire clamp in convenient working height at Centealizer deck. Caught guidewires and attached to ROV hooks/slings on guidewire clamp. Ran guidewires indivdually to 2 m above riser guide funnel at seabed. RIH to 37 m and hung off production riser in riser spider.
Picked up 2nd double - 2 ea standard joints with simulatneous lift by deck crane and TDS. Removed handling tool type E from 1st double.
Made up connection using bolt tensioner tools. Tested flange to 3000 psi through test port - ok. Installed bolt caps and fairings.
RIH with production riser to 66 m. Hung off production riser in riser spider. Removed handling flange type E. Exhaust fumes on drillfloor.
Recessed operations due to exhaust fumes on drillfloor.
Picked up 3rd double - lower std joint #2 and splash zone jnt with simulatneous lift by deck crane and TDS.
Made up connection using bolt tensioner tools. Tested flange to 3000 psi through test port - ok. Installed bolt caps and fairings.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Laid out 2 ea HPDR joints. Transferred F-5 coflex hose to XMT deck. Prepared for running production riser. Ran production riser and entered riser guide funnel with TBC.

activities.remarks: RIH with production riser to 95 m. Hung off production riser in riser spider. Removed handling flange type E.
Picked up 4th double - upper pup joint and tensioner joint with simultaneous lift by deck crane and TDS.
Made up connection using bolt tensioner tools. Tested flange to 3000 psi through test port - ok. Installed bolt caps and fairings.
RIH with production riser to 118 m. Hung off production riser with hang off plate in riser spider.
Removed handling flange. Picked up stand with premade running flange. Made up flange to tensioner joint. Picked up weight and removed hang off plate.

RIH on 5 1/2" DP stand to land TBC on wellhead. Observed with ROV and used pusher tool to help TBC to enter riser guide funnel. Observed in riser guide funnel window while coming down. Ran TBC to +/- 10 cm above bottom of window.
Released 6 MT guidewire from template and ROV hook on riser guidewire clamp. Retrieved guidewire to surface. Released 10 MT guidewire.
Hooked 10 MT guidewire on funnel. Removed RLGF. Oriented TBC ROV panels by rotating 1/8" turn counterclokwise. Ran and established hotstab in TBC receptacle.

Landed TBC/production riser on wellhead and set down 15 MT. Verified TBC fullly landed by oserving marker/band on TBC. Locked TBC connector by pressurising port A1 to 2500-3000 psi. Observed upwards movement on TBC upper body when locking TBC.
Took 10 MT overpull on TBC to verify locked.
Moved hotstab to port B1 and flushed lower dog cavity and upper piston cavity according to Vetco procedure.

Measured and marked groves on tensioner joint. Installed centralizer and boat collision stool in Centralizer deck. Made up contact ring. Made up tensioner assembly half hubs. Raised tensioner assembly to contact ring using tensioner cylinders. Adjusted pressure to 90 bar and transferred tension from block to tension cylinders. Installed centralizer in Tensioner deck.
Made up TDS to landing strand. Filled production riser with seawater pumping from cement unit.
Pressure tested production riser against VMB plug to 20/345 bar 5/10 min - ok.

Measured and marked tensioner joint 141,4 cm above Tensioner deck. Rigged up, adjusted and dressed Norse cutting equipment on tensioner joint. Barriered off area. Adjusted block weight to put slight overpull at cut height. Drained riser through port on running flange.

Cut riser according to Norse cutting procedure. Retrieved cut part of tensioner joint. Removed riser spider. Installed outer ring and masterbushing. Broke out landing stand. Laid out cut part of tensioner joint. Installed hole cover in RT.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Oriented TBC panels. Landed and locked TBC. Installed tensioner assembly on Centralizer deck. Transferred tension from block to tension cylinders. Pressure tested production riser to 20/345 bar 5/20 min. Cut tensioner joint on Tensioner deck. Transferred annulus valves to Centralizer deck. Installed and oriented 13 3/8" surface wellhead.

activities.remarks: Put debris barrier inside tensioner joint. Re-configured cutting jig for making bevel. Cut bevel. Used handtools to dress cut and bevel. Removed cutting jig, cleared and tided Tensioner deck.
Pulled master bushing and outer ring. Transferred 2 x annulus valves to Tensioner deck using tugger.

Installed lift cap and single joint elevator on 13 3/8" multibowl. Attached 2 tuggers for dual lift in order to avoid F-4 shut in. Lowered 13 3/8" multibowl from drillfloor to well head. Slipped multibowl over tension joint and adjusted to correct orientation 45 deg aft stb.
Retrieved tuggers. Installed F-5 hatch on Weather deck.

Pressure tested BT seals in multibowl to 35 bar - ok. Injejected and energized plastic in upper and lower BT-seals. Tested BT seals to 3000 psi / 10 min - ok. Locked in 1000 psi between BT seals. Energized multibowl slips by torquing up cap srews to 600 ft-lbs.
Installed outer ring and master bushing. Removed hatch on Weather deck.
RIH with 5 1/2" stand and made up to multibowl running tool. Performed overpull test of 5 MT on multibowl - ok.
Broke multibowl running tool with chain tong. Pulled running tool on 5 1/2" stand. Broke out and laid out running tool. Racked back 5 1/2" stand.
Confirmed measurement from RT to 13 3/8" wellhead to 19,955 m using laser.
Installed hatch on Weatherdeck.

Installed slings for installing BOP riser. Prepared for dual lift in order to avoid shut in of F-4/F-14. Attached 75 MT shackle in each bail. Primary lift sling 30 MT shackles  + 10 m / 10 MT sling attached to 7,5 MT pad eyes with 25 MT shackles. Secondary lift sling in each bail -  12 MT shackle + 11 MT sling + 8,5 MT sling + 11 MT sling choked around neck of BOP/NT-2 connector.
Installed VR plugs, blind flange and annulus valves on wellhead outlets and tested each component accordingly.
Inspected TDS for loose items after maintenance.
Held toolbox talk for lifting and installing BOP joint.
Removed hatch on Weatherdeck. Removed outer ring and master bushing in RT.
Ran surface riser with TDS and dual lift to 0,5 m above 13 3/8" wellhead. Removed hole cover and cleaned seal surface. Installed seal ring. Alligned connector and landed NT-2 connector.
Made up NT-2 connector according to Vetco procedure. Took 2,5 MT overpull on connector.
Barriered off wellhead module. Installed split hatch on Weatherdeck. Built scaffolding on Weatherdeck for access to BOP connection.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Pressure tested multibowl seals. Broke and pulled WH running tool. Made up DP stand and pull tested multibowl. Installed VR plugs, blind flanges and annulus valves on wellhead and tested same. Ran and landed BOP riser joint with dual lift. Made up BOP riser joint. Built scaffolding on Weather deck. Nippled up BOP. Installed BOP overshot joint.

activities.remarks: Covered scaffolding with canvas. Covered gap between riser and Weatherdeck with aluminum cover. Released BOP stump connector.
Skidded BOP from STB setback area and landed on BOP riser.
Made up BOP connection. Meanwhile made up swadge to TDS and tested upper/lower IBOP and standpipe to 20/345 bar 5 /10 min.
Hooked up up BOP tension cylinders to BOP. Made up bell nipple spool. Installed and made up overshot joint to BOP. Prepared for installing diverter.
Rigged up slings for installing diverter. Ran diverter.
Held toolbox talk / shift hanover meeting.
Continued making up overshot joint and diverter.
Made up 13 3/8" BOP testplug. Cleaned drains inside/outside drillers cabin due to bad smell.
RIH with 13 3/8" BOP test plug on 5 1/2 DP stand and landed in surface wellhead at 20 m MD.
Lined up cement unit to BOP kill inlet and filled prodcution riser and BOP with seawater prior to pressure test.
Closed MPR. Pressure tested BOP connection 35/345 bar 5/10 min - ok.
Strapped pipe according to Vetco instructions. Strapped RT to landing point to 20,46 m MD, but questioned value.
Function tested BOP pipe rams and annular.
Re-strapped pipe according to Vetco instructions. When puttig on hole cover the hinged lid came loose and was lost into the riser/well.

Item lost in hole was a steel plate of 18 x 20 cm. Discussed situation and made plan for attempting to fish. Found that clearance (6 mm) between the riser and the 13 3/8" BOP test plug would make it impossible for the lid to pass the plug. Drained BOP to get dry access to BOP through ram door. Prepared fishing magnet on rope.
Opened LPR ram doors. Drained riser. Picked up to 11,5 m MD in order to get pictures of fish. Got pictures showing lid resting on top of 13 3/8" test plug.

Picked up in steps to +/- 10 m and took pictures through bonnet door for each incremental movment to observe position of fish. Observed lid leaning over into the larger 18 3/4" ID close to the BOP, i.e. in position to attmept fishing with magnet. Put magnet on rope into riser through ram door. Latched fish with magnet and caught through ram door.

Inspected fish and found that the pin in the broken hinge was still missing. Estimated missing pin to be 26 mm x 9 mm OD. Discussed situation. Decided to continue picking up in small increments in case pin was caught in the lip seal of the 13 3/8" test plug.
Picked up in steps of 1-2" and took pictures through bonnet door accordingly. Picked up to lips seal was visible in larger riser ID, but found no evidence of pin being trapped in lip seal.

POOH with 13 3/8" test plug. Observed for lost pin through ram doors when passing LPR with 13 3/8" test plug. Pulled 13 3/8" test plug to surface. Found small brass washer originating from the broken hinge on top of the plug. No pin recovered (later found missing pin trapped behind lip seal). Closed doors on LPR.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Ran diverter. Nippled up overshot joint. Ran BOP test plug. Tested BOP connection to 20/345 bar 5/10 min. POOH with test plug and strapped DP. Lost part of holecover in hole. Drained BOP and opened BOP bonnet to catch fish which was resting on top of BOP test plug. Caught fish with magnet. POOH and replaced and ran BOP test plug. Closed ram doors and atttempted to test BOP - observed leakage visually. Opened BSR ram doors. Re-tested BOP to 345 bar - found leakage to be hydraulic fluid. POOH with test plug and strapped pipe for surface WH datum.

activities.remarks: Inspected 13 3/8" plug and found worn lip seal. Broke out and laid down plug. Traced and made up back up 13 3/8" test plug. Closed doors on LPR.

RIH with 13 3/8" test plug and landed in surface wellhead at 20 m MD. Lined up cmented unit and filled BOP with seawater through kill line. Closed UPR. Pressure tested BOP against test plug to 20/345 bar 5/10 min. Observed leakage possibly from BSR ram door/bonnet. Bled off pressure.
Pressured up to 345 bar in order to locate leakage. Located leakage possibly across BSR ram door.
Drained BOP. Opened BSR doors. Inspected and cleaned seals, found no evident damage. Closed BSR doors.
Lined up cement unit and filled BOP with seawater. Pressure tested BOP to 345 bar / 10 min -ok. Observed and found leak to be from the BOP hydraulic system.
POOH with 13 3/8" test plug and strapped pipe according to Vetco instructions.
Strapped pipe according to Vetco instructions. Calculated 10 3/4" landing point to be 20,866 m RT.
Picked up bowl protector seetting tool and made up to 13 3/8 bowl protector.
RIH with 13 3/8" bowl protector at 20,44 m MD. POOH and laid down running tool.
Cleared and tidied drillfloor. Held toolbox talk prior to racking back tie-back tools.
Picked up and made up 10 3/4" Itco spear to stand of 5 1/2" DP. Racked back in derrick. Cleaned windows on drillers cabin for safety due to poor visiblity.
Picked up and made up adjustment sub actuation tool to 5 1/2" DP stand. Racked back in derrick.
Held toolbox talk for picking up 10 3/4" casing hanger / adjustment sub.
Picked up up 10 3/4" casing hange / adjustment sub and hung off in rotary.Made up casing hanger handling tool accroding to Vetcc instructions. Laid out assembly.
Held toolbox talk for running annulus insert retrieval tool.
Made up annulus insert J-slot retrieval tool and RIH 5 1/2" DP. Strapped pipe and checked serial numbers when running in.
Landed off at 139,89 m MD and engaged J-slot tool according to Vetco instructions. Pulled free annulus insert.
POOH with annulus insert on 5 1/2" DP and strapped pipe to check measurements. Calculated tie-back adapter no-go to 139,75 m MD.
Broke out and laid down annulus insert and retrieval tool.
Picked up and made up jet sub to stand of 5 1/2" DP.

RIH with jet sub on 5 1/2" Dp from surface to subsea wellhead 140 m MD. Made 6 passes +/- 2m across subseawellhead while circualtion at 3000 lpm / SPP 22 bar. Displaced production riser to TSW by circualting 3000 lpm / 22 bar. Pumped a total of 50 m3 TSW.
POOH with jetting sub from 140 m MD to surface. Broke and laid out jet-sub.
RIH with bowl protector pulling tool. Engaged bowl protector. Strapped pipe in and out to 20,44 m (20,86 m to 10 3/4" casing hanger lading point).
POOH with bowl protector. Broke and laid out bowl protector and running tool.

Lifted 10 3/4" casing tong to IR rails. Rigged up BX elevator. Removed master bushing and installed FMS in rotary and hooked up same. Hooked up and function testred casing tong. Re-arranged and tested HTS rollers.
Picked up 10 3/4" tie-back adapter using tugger and single joint elevator. Removed protector and inspected thread and O-rings. Hung off in FMS and secured with dog collar.
Held toolbox talk prior to running tie-back casing.
Ran 10 3/4" - C95 60,7# VamTop tie-back casing to 15 m MD.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Set bowl protector. Made up and racked back Itco spear and adjustment sub. Retrieved annulus insert. RIH with jet sub and washed subsea wellhead with 3000 lpm, displaced to TSW. Retrieved bowl protector. Rigged up for running 10 3/4" tie-back casing. Ran 10 3/4" tie-back casing, adjustable sub and 10 3/4" casing hanger. Engaged Itco spear and RIH with tie-back casing to tag depth of 138,8 m MD. Made up tie-back adapter. POOH with Itco spear.

activities.remarks: Ran 10 3/4" - C95 60,7# VamTop tie-back casing from 15 m to 99 m MD.
Picked up and made up 10 3/4" 8,89 m space out pup.

Removed BX elevator and changed to DP elevator. Picked up 10 3/4" casing hanger / adjustment sub assembly and made up same. Removed rubber protection and checked casing hanger according to Vetco proecdure.
Picked up stand with 10 3/4" Itco spear with PRS. Made up TDS while holding stand with PRS.

RIH and engaged spear in 3 m pup joint below 10 3/4" hanger by rotating string counterclockwise while picking up, obtained weight of tie-back string of 80 MT. Noted block height when casing hanger flush with RT.

RIH with tie-back casing on Itco spear and tagged tie-back threads at 139,8 m with 2-3 MT (i.e. approx 15 cm deeper than expected). Checked colour band through B-annulus on Tensioner deck, observed centre of 2nd orange band.

Put horizontal and vertical mark on pipe to count turns and measure elevation. Started rotation at 3 rpm clockwise and counted turns. Lost grip on Itco spear due to too much weight being slacked off when the block weight increased. Re-engaged spear by conterclockwise rotation. Resumed rotation and let block weight incrase approx 8 MT. Stopped rotation after an estimated 4-5 turns obtained, judging from effective rotation and travel on colour bands. Took overpull to 10 MT and set torque limit to 10,17 kNm. Resumed rotation at 3 rpm. Torque and weight increased and peaked at 7,03 kNm before Itco spear released. Estimated total downwards travel 2,5-3 inches. Re-attempted torquing up tie-back adapter twice, spear released at 3-5 kNm. Re-engaged spear and took overpull on tie.back adapter to 30 MT.
Released 10 3/4" Itco spear and POOH with same. Racked back stand in derrick. Prepared for rigging down casing tong.
Rigged down casing tong. Removed FMS and installed master bushing and bowl. Picked up adjustment sub actuation tool. Made up TDS.
RIH with adjustment sub actuation tool to 28,72 m MD to locate actuation dogs in polish bore (1st target).
Pressured up through DP to 140 bar to actuate horizontal latch dogs.

Picked up to 2nd target and confirmed horizontal dogs latching into profile, took 5 MT overpull. Confirmed measurements. Rotated pipe 3 turns clockwise and obtained 2 kNm torque. Bled off pressure on DP to zero. Checked measurement towards rotary - no movement.

Rotated pipe clockwise to retract adjustment sub. Obtained 6,5 turns on adjustment sub before stalling out on 10 kNm. Took 30 MT overpull and rotated 1/8 turn clockwise before stalling out at 6 kNm. Continuosly checked colour bands through annulus outlet on Tensioner deck. Checked elevation of casing hanger -ok.

Slacked off overpull and came down to 1st tool target (sealbore). Waited 2 minutes for horizontal dog crest to relax. Picked up again and got unexpected overpull of 4-5 MT 20 cm above 2nd tool target (latch groove). Slacked off pipe and picked up againg in attempt to free tool, got overpull at 2nd tool target. Made several attempts to free pipe by coming up and down with tool, not able to pass 2nd target. Pressured up on pipe to 120 bar. Re-attempted passing 2nd target - negative. Bled off pressure. Worked pipe with +/- 5 MT at 2nd target - not able to pass. Tool was free to move down.
Discussed situation with town. Made plan of action.

Re-attempted comming free with adjustable sub actuation tool. Attempted to pull with 10 MT overpull - negative. Pressured up pipe to 115 bar twice in attempt to manipulate horizontal latch dogs. Worked pipe several times with ~ 10 MT overpull - not able to pass 2nd tool target.
Held planning meeting for discussing contingency operations. Made plan of action.
Held toolbox meeting prior to contingency operations.

Pressured up on DP to 130 bar to make sure horizontal latch dogs and vertical torque dogs engaged in adjustable sub profiles, maintained pressure throughout operation. Adjusted block weight to 81 mT (~1 MT overpull). Extended adjsutable sub while rotating 1-2 rpm / torque 2-3 kNm. Observed torque peak of 7,09 kNm when rotation and torque transferred to tie-back adapter. Verified correct 10 3/4" casing hanger travel by observing colour bands through annulus outlet.

POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing on 5 1/2" DP stand from 140 m to 119 m MD. Hung 10 3/4" casing in manual casing slips and secured with dog collar. Observed top of casing hanger packed with dirt/cuttings. Moved casing tong to access IR.

Installed C-plate on top of 10 3/4" casing hanger. Bled off pressure on DP to zero. Adjusted pipe height to access 1st DP single with IR. Broke connection on 1st single (service breaking). Hung off DP in C-plate and screwd out connection with chain tongs. Racked back 5 1/2" DP double.

Installed DP elevator between C-plate and DP coupling and secured with cargo straps. Installed 10 3/4" BX elevator underneath 10 3/4" casing hanger. Removed drilling bails and DP elevator. Installed 10 3/4" BX elevator. Installed long bails and connected to 10 3/4" BX elevator. Moved casing tong to IR rails. Hooked up casing tong.
POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing to access coupling underneath 10 3/4" casing hanger /adjustable sub assembly. Hung off on manual slips and secured with dog collar.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: RIH with adjustment sub actuation tool. Retracted adjustment sub according to Drillquip procedure. Not able to come free with tool with 5 MT overpull. Discussed situation. Not able to come free with 10 MT overpull. Discussed sitaution. Reverted to contingency plan. Released and POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing with stuck tool. Broke casing connection and found tool packed with cuttings/dirt. Discussed situation. POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back caing.

activities.remarks: Broke casing connection while rotating pipe/bails counterclockwise with TDS. Pulled out until adjustment sub actuation tool in heigh with casing coupling. Observed horizontal latch dog profile packed with cuttings/dirt. Took pictures for reference. Removed dirt/cuttings as required.
Discussed situation. Decided to pull 10 3/4" tie-back casing for cleaning well.
Ripped off horizontal dog latch crest. Stabbed adjustable sub actuation tool into 10 3/4" casing. Made up casing coupling. Landed 10 3/4" casing hanger in slips and secured with dog collar.
Removed long bails and BX elevator. Rigged up short bails.
Held toolbox talk prior to laying out DP single (innerstring).
Connected bails to DP elevator on top of C-plate. Removed cargo straps. Pulled out DP single with adjustable sub actuation tool and laid out same. Removed C-plate.
Picked up casing hanger handling tool and made up to 10 3/4" casing hanger. POOH to 110 m MD. Broke connection between assembly and 10 3/4" space out pup.
Held toolbox talk prior to POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing. Changed to 10 3/4" BX elevator.
POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing from 110 m to 87 m MD.
POOH with 10 3/4" tie-back casing from 87 m MD to surface.
Held toolbox talk for rigging down casing running equipment.
Rigged down casing tong. Removed 10 3/4" BX elevator and installed DP elevator. Cleaned and tidied drillfloor.
Picked up bowl protector RT and made up to stand of 5 1/2" DP. Made up bowl protector to RT.
RIH with bowl protector on 5 1/2" DP stand and landed same at 20,44 m MD.
POOH with bowl protector RT, broke and laid out same.
Made up Vetco jet sub. RIH with jet sub and located across BOP. Made 3 passes across BOP cavities while pumping at 4600 lpm / SPP 62 bar.
RIH with jet sub on 5 1/2" from 10 m to 140 m MD. Made up TDS to each stand. Washed down with 3300-3900 lpm / SPP 26-38 bar.
Washed across subsea wellhead/tie-back threads at 4000 lpm / SPP ~32bar, made 5 passes. Pumped 4 m3 hi-vis pill. Displaced production riser to TSW.
POOH with jet sub on 5 1/2" DP and laid out same. Cleaned and tidied drillfloor.
Made up bowl protector RT to 5 1/2 " stand. Pulled bowl protector at 20,44 m, broke and laid out RT.
Made up jets sub. RIH with jestsub on 5 1/2" DP stand. Made 2 passes across surface wellhead pumping 3600 lpm / SPP 39 bar. POOH with jetsub.
Held toolbox talk for laying out jetsub.
Laid out jetsub. Cleard and tidied drillfloor.

Picked up adjustment sub actuation tool on single. Broke single and laid out actuation tool. Made up single to double to get full stand. Made up back-up adjustment sub actuation tool dressed with new horizontal latch ring. Racked back tool and 5 1/2" DP stand.
Held toolbox talk prior to rigging casing running equipment.
Changed to 10 3/4" BX elevator. Installed PS-30 slips dressed for 10 3/4" casing. Lifted casing tong onto IR rails and hooked up same.
Held toolbox talk prior to running 10 3/4" tie-back casing.
Lifted back-up tie-back adapter onto HTS.
Ran 10 3/4" - C95 60,7# VamTop tie-back casing from surface to 39 m MD.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: POOH with tie-back casing. Set bowl protector. Jetted BOP and subsea wellhead. Displaced riser to TSW. Pulled bowl protector. Jetted surface wellhead. Rig up for runnig tie-back casing. Ran 10 3/4" tie-back casing, adjustment sub and casing hanger. Landed tie-back casing on spear. Made up tie-back adapter in subsea wellhead. RIH with adjustment sub actuation tool, attempted to set retract adjustable sub - negative.

activities.remarks: Ran 10 3/4" - C95 60,7# VamTop tie-back casing from 39 m to 108 m MD.

Picked up 10 3/4" casing hanger / adjustment sub assembly with handling tool. Made up assembly. RIH to 119 m MD and hung off in RT. Broke off casing hanger handling tool with chaintong and laid out same. Drained riser by opening annulus valves.
Picked up stand with spear in TDS and made up to TDS. Engaged spear in pup joint below 10 3/4" casing hanger (i.e. 3 m in from top of hanger).

RIH with 10 3/4" casing hanger on spear. Tagged tie-back threads with 3-4 MT at 139,7 m MD, i.e. approx 10 cm shallower than expected. Attempted to rotated clockwise with 2700 Nm, stalled out after 1/4 turn. Rotated counterclokwise 1/2 turn, worked string and came approx 10 cm further down (corresonding to previous landing datum). Resumed clockwise rotation at 3 rpm and entered threads within 2700 Nm limit. Slacked off weight accordingly for each 2-3 MT gained on block. Observed color bands through annulus outlet to confirm travel and height.

Increased torque limit to 10170 Nm. Pulled 5 MT overpull and resumed rotation. String stalled with 7 kNm+ (6,52 kNm Nm recorded on Geoservice screen). Increased to 2 MT overpull, resumed rotation - stalled out on approx 3 kNm and spear released. Re-enaged spear. Took 13 MT overpull and resumed rotation, stalled out on 8 kNm+ (5,72 kNm recorded on Geoservice screen). Took overpull to 30 MT.
Released spear and POOH. Broke out TDS connection and set back stand and spear in derrick.
Picked up stand with adjustable sub actuation tool in PRS and made up to TDS. Measured in to 1st tool target.

Pressured up pipe to 140 bar to activate the adjustment sub actuation tool. Picked up to 2nd tool target to engage horizontal latch dogs and torque dogs. Observed 3-4 MT overpull at 2nd tool target. While maintaining overpull started rotation with 1 rpm. Rotated 2 turns / ~1 kNm. No movement observed on hanger at Tensioner deck. Wrong indications. Reattempted setting sequence with same negative result.
Made another attempt on adjustable sub setting sequence. While maintaining overpull rotated 7 turns and retracted adjustment sub as per procedure.
Bled off pressure in DP, slacked off 1 m and waited 3 min to allow lock ring to be fully retracted. PU and POOH with adjustment sub actuation tool. Cleaned and cleared rig floor.
RD csg tong. Changed from PS30 slips to to master bushings. Broke down and LO spear and adjustment sub.
PU and MU HRT. RIH with HRT on 5 1/2" HWDP from surface to 20,77 m. MU HRT to 10 3/4" surface hanger by 10 left hand turns.

MU TDS. Performed tool box meeting before lining up to test 10 3/4" tie-back csg. Verified line-up and pressured up to leak test 10 3/4" surface tie-back csg and 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg against VMB plug to 380 bar/10 min with cmt unit. 900 ltrs pumped. Test failed.
Performed line test to 380 bar/10 min with cmt unit. Test failed.
Greased surface valves on STP manifold and performed line test. Test failed.
RU pump-in sub and hose directly from cmt test line. Performed line test to 380 bar/10 min with cmt unit. Ok.

Performed line test to 380 bar/10 min with cmt unit. Ok. Leak tested 10 3/4" surface tie-back csg and 10 3/4" x 9 5/8" csg against VMB plug to 380 bar/10 min with cmt unit. Ok. 605 ltrs pumped and 560 ltrs bled back.
Released HRT by 10 right hand turns. POOH and LD same. RD cmt line.
RU to RIH with 10 3/4" MS-T seal assy RT. Found RT dressed for pulling MS-T seal and had to re-adjust length to fit the latch dogs.

Re-adjusted length on RT to fit the latch dogs to be able to run MS-T seal.

Meanwhile held Time-out for safety (TOFS) on rig floor and discussed lifting and tugger handling.
Continued RU to RIH with 10 3/4" MS-T seal assy RT.

RIH with seal assy RT and MS-T seal from surface to 20.77 m. Landed out on 10 3/4" csg hanger and locked RT into riser. Sat MS-T seal by applying 4300 psi. Tested seal through test port in multibowl to 380 bar/10 min. Ok.
Released MS-T seal RT from 10 3/4" csg hanger and POOH with RT. LO RT and removed hydraulic hoses.

Held tool box meeting. MU and RIH with secondary bowl protector from surface to 20.53 m. Installed secondary bowl protector in surface wellhead. POOH and racked back RT. Cleared rig floor of excess equipment.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Retracted adjustment sub according to Drillquip procedure. Ran casing hanger running tool and tested upper tie-back to 380 bar/10 min. Sat MS seal and test same. Ran bowl protector in surface wellhead. MU and RIH with DP and VMB retrieving tool. Circulated out Hi-vis pill with 40 m3 packer fluid. Released VMB plug.

activities.remarks: Held tool box meeting prior to retrieving VBM plug. MU VBM plug RT to 5 1/2" HWDP. Changed out master bushings for PS21 slips.
RIH with VBM plug RT on 5 1/2" HWDP and 5 1/2" DP from surface to 632 m. Up weight 98 MR/down weight 93 MT/ 2.6 kNm at 10 rpm.
Established parameters and circulated 2x btms up (20 m3) at 2000 lpm/10 bar to displace out hi-vis pill on top of plug according to program.

RIH with VBM plug on 5 1/2" DP from 632 m to 634.5 m. Attempted to latch on to and release VBM plug by applying 15-25 MT and washing above top of plug 200-2000 lpm /0.7 -9 bar between attempts. PU 2 m without observing any overpull after each attempt. Turned string 3 turns to aligne J-slot in RT. No sucess. A total of 10 attemps was made.

Latched on to and release VBM plug by applying 20 MT and then PU to 10 MT up weight on plug to verify that RT was properly latched on plug. Reduced weight on plug to 2 MT and pressured up DP to 30 bar (66 ltrs pumped) . Rotated DP 3/4" turn RH to open ball valve. Pressure dropped from 30 bar to 4 bar. 

Rotated 15 turns RH to release plug. Pulled up to 632,5 m and waited 10 min to allow elements to fully retract. RIH to 636.5 m to ensure that plug was free.

POOH with VBM plug and RT on 5 1/2" DP from 632 m to OOH. Pulled PS21 slips, cleaned rig floor rotary and installed master bushings. LO VBM plug.

Meanwhile changed inserts in PS30 slips to fit 7" tubing, inspected PRS and load tested manrider.
MU and RIH with secondary bowl protector pulling tool from surface to 20.5 m. Pulled secondary bowl protector from surface wellhead. POOH and LO RT.

Held tool box talk before RU csg equipment. RU Odfjell csg tong and prepared to run 7" tubing. Connected torque/turn computer. Prepared manual slips for running completion assemblies. Lifted in place BOT cable drum on port fwd setback area.

MU and RIH with 7 1/2" seal stem with ratcheting mule shoe assembly. Function tested ratcheting mule shoe. MU and ran two 7"  tubing joints according to tally. MU and RIH 7" x 9 5/8" Granite production packer and one 7" tubing joint.
RIH with 7" tubing in stds from 46 m to 505 m. Running speed was 5-8 stds/hr.
RIH with 7" tubing from 505 m to 891 m. Running speed was 6-8 jnts/hr.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: POOH and LD VBM plug. Pulled bowl protector. Prepared to run completion. MU and RIH with lower completion assemblies. RIH with 7" tubing from surface to 1330 m.

activities.remarks:
RIH with 7" tubing from 891 m to 1330 m. Running speed was 6-8 jnts/hr.

Changed boxes on 2 jnts and rejecting 2 jnts.

RIH with 7" tubing from 1330 m to 2304 m. Running speed was 7-8 jnts/hr. 

A total of 4.0 hrs was used changing boxes on 5 jnts and rejecting 5 joints. Inspected joints on deck and found 5 jnts with potential damaged box end.Serviced and greased csg tong and elevator.

Held tool box talk prior to lifting in DHSV assembly. PU and MU DHSV assembly. RIH with DHSV assy through rotary and installed one joint above DHSV. PU DHSV to working height. RU sheave wheel in tugger and stabilized using aft PRS. Flushed and connected control line.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: RIH with 7" tubing from 1330 to 2306 m. MU TRSCSSV. Connected and leak tested control line to 520 bar/10 min. RIH with 7" tubing and TRSCSSV CL from 2306 m to 2657 m.

activities.remarks: Tested CL to 520 bar/10 min. Ok. Bled down pressure to zero. 240 ml bled back. Pressured up CL to 345 bar to keep DHSV open. Isolated PS30 slips guide insert and made final adjustments to position slips and sheave in derrick.
RIH with 7" tubing, TRSCSSV CL and clamps from 2306 m to 2657 m. Running speed was 6 jnts/hr. Kept 345 bar on CL to maintain DHSV open while RIH.

RIH with 7" tubing, TRSCSSV CL and clamps from 2657 m to 2758 m. Running speed was 6 jnts/hr. Kept 345 bar on CL to maintain DHSV open while RIH. Performed final count of tubing jnts. Moved HTS and rollers.

Installed swedge and space-out stand and made up to TDS. Started to circulate 200 lpm using mud pump. RIH with space-out string and stung into top of liner at 2812 m. Sat down 5 MT. Measured distance from top of tubing to mark on space-out string to be 39.25 m.
PU and MU selected jnt and pup-jnts according to calculated space-out.

Changed from PS30 to master bushings. PU tubing hanger with handling tool and MU to last jnt of tubing sitting in the slips. Secured control lines with a clamp on upper tubing coupling. Lowered TH down to working height.

Cut CL 3 m above TH and fed CL through TH swagelok fittings. All spare penetrations was plugged onshore. MU fittings and leak tested all penetrations/fittings through 1/8" test port 35/380 bar 5/10 min using BOT pump. Ok. Installed C-plate and landed off TH. BO handling tool and LO same. Wrapped CL 3 times around hanger neck.

Installed communication collar onto TH by rotating 5 turns clockwise. Connected DHSV CL to 1/4" communication port at btm of communication collar. MU THRT to communication collar using 8 turns counter clockwise.

Connected DHSV CL to 1/4" communication port on top of THRT. Connected hydraulic test pump and pressure tested DHSV CL to 570 bar/10 min. Ok. Bled back 420 ml. Connected THRT lock/unlock lines from Vetco reel to THRT. Left 570 bar in DHSV CL while RIH.

PU C-plate and RIH with TH. Cleared rig floor of excess equipment. PU and MU landing jnts. Up weight 180 MT/down weight 135 MT. RIH with TH. Tagged top of liner with 5 MT. Made 3 shifts with ratcheting muleshoe before stung into liner PBR and landed TH on no-go shoulder in multibowl. Slacked off weight until fully landed out. 

Verified correct TH land off and TH seal integrity by leak testing through port #1 and #2 on multibowl to 70 bar/5 min. Bled off pressure in all CLs. Pressured up function line to 3000 psi to engage TH lock down ring. Performed pull test on TH to 15 MT to verify hanger lock down.

Pressure tested TH seal through test port #2 in multibowl to 35/380 bar for 5/10 min. Ok.

Meanwhile lined up from cmt unit to well and flushed lines.

Performed line test aginst lo-torque valve on pump-in sub to 380 bar/10 min. Dropped 1.7 bar/10 min. 85 ltrs pumped. Opened lo-torque valve. Pressured up to 50 bar/5 min to check for pressure integrity prior to setting packer. Ok. 550 ltrs pumped due to tubing drained when landing TH.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Performed space out of tubing. Pulled back and installed space out joints/pups. MU tubing hanger assy. Terminated CL. MU communication collar and TH RT. RIH, land and test TH. Performed low pressure tubing leak test and function tested TRSCSSV. Sat production packer and leak tested tubing to 380 bar/15 min. Inflow tested TRSCSSV to 320 bar/30 min. RU to test annulus.

activities.remarks:
Closed DHSV and bled off above to 5 bar above. 120 ltrs bled back indicating DHSV not closed. Opened DHSV and pressured up and equalized above to 50 bar. 120 ltrs pumped. Observed drop in pressure on BOT pump indicating DHSV open, but had only 280 ml bled back.  Repeated sequenze 2 more times before we got good indication that DHSV was fully open and had 220 ltrs bled back.

Repeated function test of DHSV. Closed DHSV and bled off above to 5 bar. 80 ltrs bled back. Observed for 10 min to confirm that DHSV was fully closed and not leaking. Ok. Opened DHSV and pressured up and equalized above to 50 bar. 80 ltrs pumped. Observed drop in pressure on BOT pump indicating DHSV open. Bled off pressure down to 5 bar. 220 ltrs bled back.

Pressured up tubing from 5 bar to 380 bar. 1386 ltrs pumped. Kept 570 bar on DHSV CL. Held pressure for 15 min to set packer and test tubing. Ok. Had 1.3 bar drop. 

Observed load vibration noise on rig floor when pressure reached 260 bar. Investigated TH and all well head levels. No findings.

Bled off tubing pressure and observed pressure dropped immediately to zero. Concluded that lead target blocked cmt line. This was in accordance with observed noise. Bled off tubing pressure carefully to zero. Had 1360 ltrs bled back.
Lined up through cmt kill line. Performed line test 30/380 bar for 5/10 min. Had 1.4 bar drop.

Pressured up tubing to 330 bar while keeping 570 bar on DHSV CL. 1157 ltrs pumped. Closed DHSV and bled off pressure above DHSV to 260 bar. 20 ltrs bled off. Inflow tested DHSV to 70 bar diff/15 min. Had 1.3 bar drop.

Bled off pressure above DHSV to 10 bar. 140 ltrs bled back. Inflow tested DHSV to 320 bar diff / 30 min. Had 0.1 bar increase. Equalized pressure by pressuring up to 330 bar above DHSV and opened DHSV. 220 ltrs pumped. Bled off pressure in tubing to zero and kept DHSV open with 570 bar. 1000 ltrs bled back.
Lined up cmt unit to A-annulus, with hose connected to multibowl and tested RU to 35/380 bar for 5/10 min against annulus valve. Vented B-annulus.
Performed line test to A-annulus to 35/380 bar for 5/10 min against annulus valve using packer fluid. High pressure test dropped 1 bar in 10 min. Opened B-annulus to vent.

Pressured up A-annulus to leak test packer from below and TH from below to 35/380 bar for 5/10 min pumping brine at 70 lpm. Kept tubing open on drill floor and 570 bar on TRSCSSV CL. Pumped 117 ltrs and observed 0.01 bar drop on low pressure test. Pumped 1170 ltrs (total) and observed 0.5 bar drop on high pressure test. Had flow on both tubing and B-annulus while pressuring up A-annulus due to ballooning effect. No flow observed when pumps was shut in. Bled pressure down to zero and had 1100 ltrs in return. Bled off and shut in A and B-annulus. Closed TRSCSSV. Had leak in FWD PRS.
Worked at hight and repaired hydraulic leak in FWD PRS.
Held tool box meeting. Released landing string by 9 right hand turns. POOH and LD landing string.
RD Odfjell csg tong and control box. RD tubing handling equipment.

Held tool box meeting. Changed to 5 1/2" handling equipment. PU and MU XO 5 1/2" FH box x 3 1/2" IF box to centralizer / BPV running adaptor / BPV. RIH and landed BPV on 5 1/2" DP in TH at 20.3 m. Sat down string weight to extend locking keys and energized seals. Rotated string 8 1/2" turns clockwise to lock mandrel and free running adaptor in J-slot. POOH with running string and LD RT.

PU 2 joints of 5 1/2" HWDP and RIH and drained riser. LO jnts.

Meanwhile cleared rig floor of CL wheel, protectors and x-overs. Prepared slings for diverter and double lift for surface riser.

Held tool box talk. Attached slings to slick joint. Prepared barriers, handrails and slings. Pulled diverter and secured in set back area. Installed outer ring and master bushings. Loosened nuts on slick joint. Disconnected tension cylinders in WH module. Pulled slick joint and secured in set back area. ND NT2 connection on BOP and sat on stump.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Tested A-annulus to 380 bar. Ran BPV and sat in TH. POOH and LD landing string and TH running tool. ND diverter, BOP and surface riser. Retrieved surface riser and lifted down space spool using double lift. Installed dart in BPV. Removed communication collar, terminated CLs and installed seals for XMT. Installed space spool.

activities.remarks: Continued setting BOP on stump.
Connected slings to riser joint and removed scaffolding on NT2 connection in moonpool.
Disconnected NT2 connector on riser joint and pulled riser jnt to rig floor using double lift. Installed master bushings on rig floor and hatch on weather deck. LD riser joint.

Disconnected control lines from communication collar and hoisted same to rig floor through hole in half-moon hatch in moonpool. Installed anti vibration ring on TH. Removed one control line exit block on multi bowl. Unwrapped required length of CL around TH neck and fed control line through dedicated port on multi bowl. Fed high pressure packings and fittings onto CL and MU fittings to threads in multi bowl. Installed dart in BPV in TH by hand. Installed 137 VG seal ring on top of multi bowl and VG 63 seal ring on top of TH.

Removed master bushings on rig floor and one half-moon of hatch in moonpool. Lowered spacer spool down from rig floor with TDS and 6 MT tugger (dual lift) until NT2 box connector landed out on top of WH. MU locking dogs until connection leveled out. MU actuation screws with 800 ft-lbs.

Continued MU actuation screws with 800 ft-lbs. Disconnected slings and removed same. 

Pressure tested and energized BT seals through ports 7/8. Tested VG 63 connection trough test port 9/10 to 35 bar/5 min.

Tested TH void, grafoil seals and BT seals 35/380 bar for 5/10 min via test port 5/6.

MU ferrule swagelock fittings for CL. Installed seal rings and CL exit block. Installed seal ring on top of spacer spool.

Meanwhile cleaned cantiliver before laying out 7 5/8" tubing.

*** Operations transferred to F-99 ***

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Continued installing spacer spool. Waited for production to shut down - coordinated towards Sleipner, operations transferred to F-99.

activities.remarks:
Removed F-5 hatch on weather deck to allow XMT to pass through. Held tool box meeting. Lifted XMT over moon pool with port overhead crane. Transferred weight (XMT) from overhead crane to top drive (TDS). Lowered XMT down through weather deck hatch. Oriented and landed XMT on top of spacer spool. MU grayloc connection and disconnected slings from XMT. Pressure tested seal ring to 35 bar/10 min through test port #3 and #4 on spacer spool to confirm proper seal.

Meanwhile prepared WL equipment and cleaned inside cantiliver and in pump room.

Installed flow line spool onto XMT using 6 MT tugger from rig floor. Re-installed hatches on F-5. Notified PCR for injection start up of F-4.

Meanwhile MU and RB 1 stds of 7 5/8" csg (A total of 9 stds made up), prepared WL equipment and cleaned inside cantiliver and in pump room.

Connected flexible flow line  to flow line spool.

Meanwhile MU and RB 4 stds of 7 5/8" csg (A total of 12 stds made up), prepared WL equipment and cleaned inside cantiliver and in pump room.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Resumed work after waiting for production to shut down F-12, F-14 and F-4 at 19:30 hrs.  Lifted, oriented and landed XMT from moon pool to top of spacer spool. Installed flow line spool onto XMT. Connected up flexible flow line. Filled XMT with drill water and tested to 380 bar/10 min

activities.remarks:
Connected flexible flow line  to flow line spool.

Meanwhile MU and RB 7 stds of 7 5/8" csg (A total of 19 stds made up), lifted WL BOP's into moonpool and cleaned inside cantiliver and in pump room.

Opened HMV with Seawell test pump. Held tool box talk. Lined up from cmt unit and connected hose on KWV. Performed line test to 30/380 bar for 5/10 min against KWV. 3.0 bar drop (0.8%) on high pressure test .
Pressure tested XMT body and VG 63 ring to 30/380 bar for 5/10 min against dart in BPV. 2.0 bar (0.5%) drop on high pressure test. 50 ltrs pumped and approx 40 ltrs bled back.

Attempted to flush flowline through XMT by pumping pot water from production, but had installed check valve in front of hose from cmt unit to KWV. Removed CV and lined up from cmt unit to KWV. Performed line test to 30/380 bar for 5/10 min against KWV. 3.0 bar drop (0.8%) on high pressure test.
Open PWV. Flushed through flowline, PWV, XMT, KWV to cmt unit from production with pot water.
Pressure tested flowline/XMT to 30/345 bar for 5/10 min. 3.6 bar (1.0%) drop on high pressure test. 95 ltrs pumped and 90 ltrs bled back.

Pressured up to 130 bar against BPV & dart. Close MMV and bled off pressure above MMV to 10 bar. Inflow tested MMV to 120 bar differential pressure for 15 min. Test ok.

Equalized pressure above MMV. Opened MMV and closed HMV. Bled of any pressure above HMV to 10 bar. Inflow test HMV to 120 bar differential pressure for 15 min. Test ok.

Equalized pressure across HMV. Opened HMV. Bled off pressure. Closed valves. 

Pressure tested BOT control line exit block for DHSV to 570 bar/15 min using BOT pump. Test ok. Closed DHSV. Bled off 335 ml on line.
Built scaffolding around XMT. Opened HMV. RIH with retrieving tool for dart on stinger and retrieved dart.  POOH with dart. Pulled BPV from TH. Closed HMV and SV. Closed PWV, KWV and MMV.

Commisioned F-5 XMT.

Meanwhile installed WL BOP's (tripple BOP below dual BOP). Built scaffolding around WL BOP's and installed riser sections to rig floor.

Commisioned F-5 XMT.

Meanwhile LD 3 1/2" DP, installed BOP rams and cleaned lower shakers and moon pool area. Torture-tested 7/16" cable and cut off 1000 m.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Tested XMT to 380 bar/10 min and flowline to 345 bar/10 min. Inflow tested MMV and HMV. Pulled dart and BPV. RU WL while commisioning XMT.

activities.remarks:
Commisioned F-5 XMT.

Meanwhile LD 3 1/2" DP (16 of 31 stds layed down), installed BOP rams and cleaned lower shakers and moon pool area. Built rope socket/cable head on 7/16" cable.

Commisioned F-5 XMT.

Meanwhile LD 3 1/2" DP (31 stds layed down) and cleaned lower shakers and moon pool area. Held TOFS due to dropped 3 1/2" DP in fox hole. Tested perforation toolstring and prepared WL equipment. Bundled up and removed 3 1/2" DP from cantiliver for backload.

Commisioned F-5 XMT.

Meanwhile spotted equipment on rig floor and RU WL lubricator, grease skid, nitrogen rack and local control panel. Hot-checked perforation toolstring. Prepared for pressure testing WL rig up.
Held tool box talk prior to pressure testing WL rig up and prior to making up guns.

Hooked up local control of DHSV and HMV on XMT. Removed hydraulic tube from HMV and drained hydraulic fluid. Hooked up DHSV control hose on XMT. Hooked up HMV control hose.

Meanwhile lined up to fill riser and lubricator with cmt unit. Lifted toolstring into toolcatcher and MU lubricator to lower riser.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Continued commision XMT, LD 3 1/2" DP and RU WL equpment until 22:15. Pressure tested WL rig up. MU and armed perforation guns.

activities.remarks: Tested DHSV local control hose to 520 bar - ok. Tested HMV local control hose to 207 bar - ok.

Opened SV and and verified line up by opening KWV with 10 bar on the line. Filled riser and lubricator with packer fluid using cmt pump. Closed KWV. Leak tested line from cement pump to KWV to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min against cloed KWV using packer fluid. 1.9 bar (0.95%) drop on high pressure test. 20 ltrs pumped.

Attempted to leak test WL rig up to 30 bar/5 min, but had visual leak between two lubricator sections. Changed O-ring in leaking connection without laying down lubricator. Leak tested WL rig up to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min using packer fluid and cmt pump. 1.8 bar (0.9%) drop on high pressure test. 30 ltrs pumped and bled back. Bled off pressure to closed drain. Closed SV and KWV.

Opened MMV using 42 turns. Opened HMV by applying 207 bar on CL using local control panel. Equalized above DHSV in steps up to 15 bar (60 ltrs pumped) and opened DHSV by applying 520 bar on CL using local control panel. Closed HMV and broke off lubricator at in-situ sub.
Perforation run #1: Lowered orientating weight and 30 ft gun section into lower riser section and hung off in C-plate. Connected and armed perforating guns according to Schlumberger procedure.
Perforation run #1: Connected lubricator and re-routed tugger on lubricator due to twist with wireline sheave wheel.
Leak tested in-situ sub to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min with Seawell test pump. Ok. Observed leak in XMT instrumentation piping. Installed temporary fitting.

Opened HMV and observed 0 bar WHP. Verified TRSCSSV was open. Opened SV and RIH with 4.5" TCP guns on 7/16" electric line from surface to 3731 m MD. Up weight 1225 kg / Running weight 1170 kg at 450 m.

Bled 52 bar WHP down to zero through closed drain. Correlated guns to shooting depth using GR. Hanging weight 2350 kg. Fired guns and perforated interval #1 from 3704.0 m to 3712.0 m MD. Positiv confirmation that guns had fired, but observed no increase in WHP.

POOH and logged GR/CCL from 3700 m to 2809.5 m to top of liner (TOL). POOH with 4.5" TCP perforation guns from 2809.5 m to OOH. Powered down logging unit at 70 m below seabed. Made PA announcement and pulled cable head into tool catcher. Closed SV to verify BHA OOH.

Closed HMV. Observed no WHP. Opened bleed to closed drain as a precaution. Opened needle valve and confirmed that lubricator was empty and that the well was on vacuum.

Broke lubricator at in-situ sub. BO and LD guns using sertified lifting sub. Observed that all shots had fired.
Perforation run #2: Megged and inspected cable. Built and tested new cable head. Checked CCL on rig floor. Shut down power to Schlumberger unit according to procedure before MU perforation gun.

PU gun sections from cantiliver onto HTS. Lifted guns into riser using fwd PRS. MU firing head and CAL-B to gun hung off in riser and armed gun. PU toolstring and lifted into toolcatcher. Connected and hung off orientation weight and second gun sections in C-plate. Connected upper toolstring to guns hanging in toolcatcher. PU tension on toolstring and took off C-plate.

Connected lubricator and filled with MEG. Tested in-situ sub to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min with Seawell test pump. Ok. Opened HMV and observed 0.1 WHP. Verified TRSCSSV was open. Opened SV. RIH with 4.5" guns to 70 m below seabed and powered up logging unit.

daily_reports.remarks_combined: RIH and perforated run #1. POOH. LD gun. RIH and perforated run #2. POOH.

activities.remarks: RIH with 4.5" TCP guns on 7/16" electric line from 250 to 3731 m MD. Up weight 25000 kg / Running weight 1550 kg.

Bled 52 bar WHP down to 2 bar through closed drain. Correlated guns to shooting depth using CCL. Hanging weight 2500 kg. Fired guns and perforated interval #2 from 3682.0 m to 3700.5 m MD. Positiv confirmation that guns had fired, tension dropped 50 kg and WHP dropped to 0.5 bar.

POOH with 4.5" TCP perforation guns from 3680 m to OOH. Powered down logging unit at 70 m below seabed. Made PA announcement and pulled cable head into tool catcher. Closed SV to verify BHA OOH. Closed HMV. Observed no WHP. Opened bleed to closed drain as a precaution. Opened needle valve and confirmed that lubricator was empty and that the well was on vacuum.
Broke lubricator at in-situ sub. BO and LD guns using sertified lifting sub. Observed that all shots had fired.
Perforation run #3: Megged and inspected cable. Built and tested new cable head. Checked CCL on rig floor. Shut down power to Schlumberger unit according to procedure before MU perforation

PU gun sections from cantiliver onto HTS. Lifted guns into riser using fwd PRS. MU firing head and CAL-B to gun hung off in riser and armed gun. PU toolstring and lifted into toolcatcher. Connected and hung off orientation weight and second gun sections in C-plate. Connected upper toolstring to guns hanging in toolcatcher. PU tension on toolstring and took off C-plate.

Connected lubricator and filled with MEG. Tested in-situ sub to 30/200 bar for 5/10 min with Seawell test pump. Ok. Opened HMV and observed 0 WHP. Verified TRSCSSV was open. Opened SV. RIH with 4.5" guns to 70 m below seabed and powered up logging unit.
RIH with 4.5" TCP guns on 7/16" electric line from 250 to 3730 m MD. Up weight 2500 kg / Running weight 1550 kg.

Confirmed no WHP. Correlated guns to shooting depth using CCL. Hanging weight 2500 kg. Fired guns and perforated interval #3 from 3651.5 m to 3670.0 m MD. Positiv confirmation that guns had fired, tension dropped 50 kg.

POOH with 4.5" TCP perforation guns from 3650 m to OOH. Powered down logging unit at 70 m below seabed. Made PA announcement and pulled cable head into tool catcher. Closed SV to verify BHA OOH. Closed HMV. Observed no WHP. Opened bleed to closed drain as a precaution. Opened needle valve and confirmed that lubricator was empty and that the well was on vacuum.

Opened HMV and observed 0 WHP. Verified TRSCSSV was open. Opened KWV. Pumped /bullheaded 3 m3 100% MEG at 100 lpm and 4-5 bar into well with cmt pump to provide cusion above closed TRSCSSV. Displaced MEG to above TRSCSSV by chasing it with 6.6 m3 packer fluid at 160 lpm and 5-6 bar. Pumped 1.2 m3 100% MEG to fill XMT body.
Closed TRSCSSV and HMV. Leak tested XMT cross to 130 bar / 10 min against closed HMV. Dropped 2.0 bar / 10 min (1.5 %). Bled off pressure to zero bar. Closed KWV.
Broke lubricator at in-situ sub. BO and LD guns using certified lifting sub. Observed that all shots had been fired

daily_reports.remarks_combined: LD guns. RIH and perforate run #3. POOH. Spotted 3 m3 100% MEG on top of DHSV. Inflow tested A-annulus gate valve to 380-5 bar for 30 min. RD WL lubricator, risers and BOP's.

activities.remarks: Continued to LD and observe 4.5" perforation guns. Changed out firing head with btm nose. Re-stabbed lubricator at in-situ sub.

Lined up and leak tested line from cement unit to outer A-annulus valve to 30/380 bar for 5/10 min using packer fluid. 3.6 bar (0.95%) drop on high pressure test. 20 ltrs pumped.

Opened inner and outer A-annulus. Ensured B-annulus was open. Monitored pressure on tubing side on lubricator. Pressured up A-annulus to 380 bar. Closed inner A-annulus valve. Bled off pressure to 5 bar to cmt unit. Inflow tested inner A-annulus valve to 380 bar for 30 min using packer fluid. 0.5 bar increase on test. 1190 ltrs pumped and 1100 ltrs bled back. No leak observed on B-annulus. Vacuum on tubing side. Equalized and opened A-annulus valve. Bled off pressure.

RD lubricatoor on rig floor. Disconnected and pulled riser sections above BOP to rig floor.

Meanwhile brushed F-9 subsea wellhead before installing VX-ring.

RD hydraulic BOP hoses. Disconnected  WL BOP's and transfered to overhead crane in moonpool. 

Meanwhile brushed F-9 subsea wellhead before installing VX-ring.
Continued disconnecting  WL BOP's and transfering them by overhead crane in moonpool.

Removed manifold from XMT. Installed blind cap outside KWV and XMT tree cap with 1/2" needle valve on top. RU test hose from needle valve to Seawell test pump. Leak tested XMT cross to 35/380 bar for 5/10 min against KWV cap and XMT cap. Bled off pressure to zero. Closed needle valves and disconnected test pump. Closed KWV and SV.

Meanwhile removed hatch and lifted out UWG reel, WL BOP's and half moon hatches from moonpool to main deck.

Installed hatch on F-5 and continued removing WL equipment from moonpool.

Meanwhile disassembled scaffolding bridges from cantiliver.

Transfered operation of HMV and TRSCSSV to platform system/production. Filled in and signed "Well handover document" and handed over well from Volve D&W to Mærsk Production at 12:00. 

Meanwhile removed scaffolding around moonpool hatch. 
 ****************END OF OPERATIONS****************

daily_reports.remarks_combined: Continued RD WL equipment. Tested XMT tree cap and KWV to 35/380 bar for 5/10 min. Handed over well to production at 12:00.
